value.name: input.hasPressedActions
value.purpose: Read whether the current semantic press-edge snapshot contains any action, in O(1).
value.when_to_use: Gate a large discrete wasPressed action scanner when no action was newly pressed. Search any pressed action, has pressed actions, 是否有按下動作 or 任意按下事件. Keep action dispatch and gameplay in Luau.
value.when_not_to_use: Do not skip the whole update, held movement, release handling, pointer/drag, text editing or slider interaction work. Raw physical events alone are not semantic presses.
value.returns: boolean: at least one action would return true from wasPressed(action) in this same tick snapshot.
side_effects: Read-only O(1) input snapshot; never consumes an edge or scans action names
value.frame_semantics: Uses the same pressed set as wasPressed. Stable across repeated reads; only successful ticks advance the prior held snapshot. Failed execution restores the previously published press snapshot, reload preserves it, and a fresh runtime starts false. Existing host/UI/physical mappings and replay feed the same semantic actions; held-only, release-only, raw-physical-only, text-only and slider-only input do not create a press.
common_errors: Takes no arguments or option table; unexpected arguments are rejected. This is not an any-input-activity or pending-event query.
